scope: Actual Mathlib points/invariants, every characteristic and repeated/vertical case. Short/binary specializations and field maps are checked; no general resultant recursion, irreducibility or degree proof is asserted. Signed standing pending.
statement: On any nonsingular general Weierstrass model over an algebraically closed field of any characteristic, the explicit b-invariant S3 vanishes exactly when three actual affine elliptic points with the prescribed x coordinates sum to zero.
